tokens.npc_dota_hero_wisp_bio:
Io is everywhere, and in all things. Denounced by enemies as the great unmaker, worshiped by scholars as the twinkling of a divine eye, this strange Wisp of life-force occupies all planes at once, the merest fraction of its being crossing into physical existence at any one moment.

Like the great twin riders Dark and Light, and yet another ancient traveler whose true history is lost to the ages, Io the Wisp is a Fundamental of the universe, a force older than time, a wanderer from realms far beyond mortal understanding. Io is nothing less than the sum of all attractive and repulsive forces within the material field, a sentient manifestation of the charge that bind existence together. It is only in the controlled warping of these electrical waylines that Io's presence can be experienced on the physical plane. A benevolent, cooperative force, Io bonds its strange magnetism to others so that the power of allies might be enhanced. Its motives inscrutable, its strength unimaginable, Io moves through the physical plane, the perfect expression of the mysteries of the universe.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_wisp_hype: Io has a talent for making allies more effective. A powerful companion, the wisp's tether speeds allies and stops enemies. Capable of linking to and teleporting across the battlefield with an ally, Io can make a dangerous ally even deadlier.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Interrupts Io's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# [[File:Dota2 Io Wisps icon.png|21px|Io's Spirits]] [[File:Dota2 Clockwise.png|31px|Clockwise]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|u}} [[File:Dota2 Io Spirits Visualized icon.png|84px]]
*#* Creates each spirit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] in 1-second intervals, starting immediately upon cast or {{ValueColor||passively|agh}}, up to the max number of spirits, [[Wikipedia:Logarithmic spiral|logarithmically spiraling]] clockwise outward {{Show|A|Io|Spirits Out|value1}}-distance from Io's current location, point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] , and reaches its revolution orbit [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] .
*#** {{Code|OS {{=}} MAXDistance {{=}} {{Show|A|Io|Spirits Out|value1}}}}
*#* The first spirit ({{Code|P}}) is always created in front of Io's {{M|facing angle|t=u}}, with subsequent spirits ({{Code|P'}}) created behind the first.
*#** All spirits keep an equal distance from each other, and are centered on Io upon cast for the entire duration. 
*#** Moving the {{A|Io|Spirits In}} to Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-r.png|21px|R]] or {{A|Io|Spirits Out}} within Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] do not break their formation.
*#* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*#** All spirits not visible to the enemy if Io is {{M|invisible}}.
*# {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#* Checks for the following conditions within the collision radius:
*#** [[File:Dota2 Io Spirits Individual (Creep Radius) icon.png|42px]] {{to}} {{Symbol|Lane Creeps}}
*#*** Applies the collision [[magical]] [[spell damage]] to creeps within the creep collision radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] .
*#*** This ability component considers {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*#*** The spirits do not explode, and continues revolving within the orbit in this situation.
*#** [[File:Dota2 Io Spirits Individual (Hero Radius) icon.png|42px]] {{to}} [[File:Enemy Hero Factor abilityicon dota2 wikiasset.png|21px|Enemy Heroes]]
*#*** Applies the explosion magical spell damage to enemy heroes within the hero explosion radius if there are enemy heroes within the hero search radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] .
*#*** This ability component considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes.
*#** All ability components do not affect the following units:
*#*** {{M|Couriers}}
*#*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*# {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{to}} [[File:Enemy Hero Factor abilityicon dota2 wikiasset.png|21px|Enemy Heroes]]
*#* Applies the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|wisp_spirits_slow}} debuff upon proc within the explosion radius.
*# [[File:Dota2 Io Wisps icon.png|21px|Io's Spirits]]
*#* Remaining spirits explodes simutaneously at the end of the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|wisp_spirits}} duration.
*#** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} removes this restriciton. All created spirits now have an {{ValueColor||indefinite|agh}} duration.
*#* Recasting and reapplying the buff causes the current created spirits to immediately explode.
*#** {{cf|aghnotes}} The active component now is akin to recasting the ability upon cast.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} {{Symbol|a|Sub}}
** Both {{A|Io|Spirits In}} and {{A|Io|Spirits Out}} [[sub-abilities]] are now permanently available.
** The spirits now replenish upon explosion and have an {{ValueColor||indefinite|agh}} duration.

fields.value:
{{Gamedesc
| image = {{#var:Spirits icon0}}
| desc = Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
}}
* [[File:Dota2 Io Wisps icon.png|21px|Io's Spirits]] [[File:Dota2 Clockwise.png|31px|Clockwise]] [[File:Dota2 Io Spirits Visualized icon.png|84px]]
** Has the following unit additional properties:
*** All spirits complete a revolution per {{#var:Spirits basic1}} seconds regardless of its distance from Io.
**** Hence, {{Code|P}} can rotate at most {{#expr:floor({{#var:Spirits value5}}/{{#var:Spirits basic1}})}} times around Io.
*** The spirits' angular velocity is constant. The further the distance from Io, the faster the spirits' speed.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} while active creates new spirits, the previous active spirits disappear without exploding.
** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** The spirits does not have a {{M|death}} animation. Hence, when losing the ability upgrade, the current spirits just simply disappears.
** If the spirits do not collide with an enemy hero more than {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Spirits value1}}+1}}|agh}} seconds, the next explosion will deal twice the damage.
*** This is because once the spirit collides and explodes, the newly spawned spirit immediately takes its place, and collides with the enemy hero again.

**** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability at the {{M|faction}}'s {{M|fountain}}.

*# {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|Point}}
*#* {{#var:Relocate value1}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Relocate value1 tal}}|25tal}}) seconds after casting, [[teleports]] both Io and the {{A|Io|Tether}}-affected allied hero's to the point-targeted location
*#* For {{M|silence}} sources, the teleport component does not happen if Io is affected as the effect delay finishes.

*#** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#*** Interrupts Io's {{M|channeling}} abilities.

*#**** {{M|Root}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Stun}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Sleep}} sources.

*#*** Interrupts the affected allied hero's {{M|channeling}} abilities.

*# {{Symbol|Trees}}

*#* [[Teleport|Relocate]]s back to the original location once the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|wisp_relocate_return}} duration expires.
*#** Interrupts both Io and the affected allied hero's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
*#** Does not disjoint incoming projectiles. 
*#** {{Symbol|Disable}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
*#*** The aforementioned [[disable]] sources applied on either Io or the {{A|Io|Tether}}-affected allied hero does not prevent the relocate component from happening if Io successfuly teleports.
*#* Affects the following units:
*#** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*#** The countdown ability effects is visible to everyone.
*# {{Symbol|Trees}}
*#* [[Trees]] within 350-radius centered around both Io and the allied hero are destroyed upon relocating back.

data.bio_loc:
Io is everywhere, and in all things. Denounced by enemies as the great unmaker, worshiped by scholars as the twinkling of a divine eye, this strange Wisp of life-force occupies all planes at once, the merest fraction of its being crossing into physical existence at any one moment.

Like the great twin riders Dark and Light, and yet another ancient traveler whose true history is lost to the ages, Io the Wisp is a Fundamental of the universe, a force older than time, a wanderer from realms far beyond mortal understanding. Io is nothing less than the sum of all attractive and repulsive forces within the material field, a sentient manifestation of the charge that bind existence together. It is only in the controlled warping of these electrical waylines that Io's presence can be experienced on the physical plane. A benevolent, cooperative force, Io bonds its strange magnetism to others so that the power of allies might be enhanced. Its motives inscrutable, its strength unimaginable, Io moves through the physical plane, the perfect expression of the mysteries of the universe.
data.hype_loc: Io has a talent for making allies more effective. A powerful companion, the wisp's tether speeds allies and stops enemies. Capable of linking to and teleporting across the battlefield with an ally, Io can make a dangerous ally even deadlier.
data.npe_desc_loc: Links to its allies to buff them

abilities.name: wisp_tether
abilities.desc_loc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
abilities.lore_loc: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.
notes_loc: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
abilities.shard_loc: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.

abilities.name: wisp_spirits
abilities.desc_loc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
abilities.lore_loc: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.
notes_loc: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
abilities.scepter_loc: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

abilities.name: wisp_overcharge
abilities.desc_loc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
abilities.lore_loc: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.
facets_loc: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.

abilities.desc_loc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
